scope: Fresh authored finite inventory facts. Static content recall and wording/address access, not general memory or historical production incidents.
encoder_contract: All V11 arms use the same pinned full-precision Torch multilingual MiniLM and normalized mean pooling. V10's quantized ONNX feature cache is used only by the separate retrospective diagnostic. No numerical encoder equivalence is claimed.
presentation_contract: Identical source facts, training query rows and per-seed minibatch schedule for all four gradient-trained arms. Architecture parameter counts, wall/CPU time and storage differ and are reported; equal presentations are not equal FLOPs. Strong retrieval/registry/closed-form controls do not consume fictitious SGD budgets.
training: Only train.json and train_features.npz may be opened by fit children. Separate processes fit every arm before a calibration process runs. The adapter's initial output head matches the corresponding linear arm; internal attention query/value A and B and the head are trained. Adapter intervention uses the final head unchanged.
calibration: Choose a threshold with zero accepted unknown/ambiguous calibration queries, maximize exact-correct known acceptance, then prefer the higher threshold. If none qualifies, reject all. No held-based tuning, retries or arm replacement. Report coverage, accepted precision and false acceptance independently.
held_isolation: Held templates are read and held features generated only after all fit workers and the calibration worker have exited. Evaluators load saved checkpoints and fixed thresholds. Preserve every prediction and failed subprocess.
strong_controls: Registry performs unique literal matching against supplied known identifiers and returns exact stored values. Queries explicitly contain identifiers; this is a strong exact-address comparator, not a claim of unrestricted language understanding. Nearest uses all training wordings and values. Pinv solves a full affine map on identical training features to signed margin-8 labels.
cost: Count shared encoder bytes once, and report source/query/feature/weight/schedule/metadata bytes, training and evaluation timing, per-worker self CPU and peak RSS. Physical retained evidence is additional storage. No net superiority claim without a matched quality/cost result; cloud host scheduling and installation costs are not inferred.
freeze: Local protocol, sources, held template file and model manifest hashes are frozen before preparation/training. This does not claim independently authenticated remote publication. Any source drift or failed worker stops the run and preserves artifacts.
development_data: Development operational check uses seed 99411007 and two separate Thistle Cove/Rowan Peak texts; no formal facts or wording are used. Formal matrix outcomes never tune this protocol.
